front.title: A YANG Extension for Declaring the Comparability Scope of Operational State

abstract.t: A value exported from a YANG data tree is often unique only within its parent, for example an entry numbered 0 under two different parents. Once the value is exported without the parent's key, a collector cannot tell whether two such values refer to the same thing, and no collector-side normalization can recover the missing key. YANG (RFC 7950) has no way to state this dependency in the schema. This document defines a YANG extension statement, "csc:comparability-scope", a four-level scope lattice, a compatibility rule, and an export rule, so that the key needed to compare a value travels with it, and a schema-aware tool can detect an invalid comparison before any data is exported.
